progress_summary: Production is off the approved v1.9.0 baseline. opchain.dev/api/health serves 78567c2 (merge of PR #483, 2026-09-05 01:57Z) from Cloudflare deployment 8da6c19d-a89a-4214-8e58-4606c7ce2f72, while .github/monitoring/release-baseline.json still records 244bf13 at deployment 54ef8a21-0665-4a83-bc1a-5768c2bae0d5. Staging serves fbb24a8, a SHA on no origin branch (an off-main branch preview). Scheduled Canary runs 33970020249 (Sept 5) and 34359976498 (Sept 9) and Deploy lag runs 33971641171 and 34363685054 all failed with 'current deployment 8da6c19d… does not match baseline 54ef8a21…'. Deploy lag died before its issue step, so no tracking issue exists and 19 deploy-relevant main paths after 78567c2 are untracked. The owner confirmed on 2026-09-11 that the 78567c2 deploy was deliberate and is to be blessed. Deploy lag now files its issue on a mismatch and deploy.mjs warns when a deploy leaves the baseline stale.

key_decisions: The monitoring design uses authenticated Cloudflare control-plane APIs rather than public GitHub-hosted curl traffic challenged by Bot Fight Mode.
The approved baseline is the signed v1.9.0 tag, not the later non-deploying monitoring or checkpoint commits.
A successful workflow_dispatch validates the new baseline immediately; only a successful event=schedule cycle closes the explicit continuous-monitoring evidence requirement.
Deploy lag compares origin/main to the immutable release baseline using deploy-relevant paths, so monitoring/checkpoint-only descendants do not trigger false drift incidents.
user_preferences: Complete the v1.9 production push and release sign-off autonomously.
